items.q: Which sector includes farming and mining?
items.why: The answer examiners want is: Primary. “Secondary” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.
Correct answer: Decline of secondary manufacturing. “More factories opening” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.

items.q: Roughly what % of UK workers are now employed in services (tertiary)?
items.why: The real figure is 80. The wrong options cluster deliberately close — anchor the exact number to one concrete fact so it can't drift.
